items.title: What Does Sandisk (SNDK) Losing NAND Share To China Mean Now?
items.summary: SanDisk (NasdaqGS:SNDK) has been overtaken in global NAND memory market share by Chinese rival Yangtze Memory Technologies, according to newly released industry data. The latest figures show Yangtze Memory Technologies now holds a larger share of the NAND market than SanDisk, marking a shift in the competitive order among major memory chip producers.
